title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.24719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. translated_title: DRIFT：面向运行时灵活且高效的端到端驾驶的可分离推理
translated_abstract: 将视觉语言模型（VLM）集成到端到端（E2E）自动驾驶中，凭借其场景描述和推理能力展现出了强大的潜力。然而，VLM的计算开销高昂，并且在运行时动态开启和关闭语言推理而不损害闭环性能这一点尚未得到验证，这阻碍了其实际应用。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DRIFT——一个集成了轻量级语言模型（LM）的端到端自动驾驶框架，用于视觉问答和动作解说。通过将中间驾驶表征高效地投影到语言嵌入空间，我们证明了一个紧凑的语言模型（参数量小于1.5亿）即可实现强大的场景描述和动作解说能力。此外，我们引入了一个运行时灵活的规划模块，该模块在从语言模型蒸馏出的代理推理特征上进行训练，并且可以以语言模型的输出或其他条件作为输入进行调节（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: DRIFT提出了一种端到端自动驾驶框架，利用小于1.5亿参数的轻量级语言模型实现场景描述与动作解说，并引入可在运行时灵活开关语言推理的规划模块，且不损害闭环驾驶性能，从而兼顾推理能力与计算效率。
en_tdlr: DRIFT is an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that uses a compact language model (<150M parameters) for scene description and action commentary, and introduces a runtime-flexible planning module that can toggle language reasoning on and off without hurting closed-loop performance, balancing reasoning capability with computational efficiency.
